_comment: v0.2.100 WP-18B: the FRONTMATTER of the 7 agent templates as v0.2.99 shipped them (git show 54109773:templates/agents/free/<name>.md, up to and including the closing ---),
with the owner-removed `orchestrator-tools` mcpServers block whose server never existed and whose interpreter path ({{ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT}}/claude_mcp_servers/.venv/bin/python) no install has.
tests/test_v02100_wp18b_materialization_gaps.py rebuilds the v0.2.99 template as <this frontmatter> + <current body>, installs it, then updates to the shipped template and asserts the
stale render is REPLACED (an untouched file overwritten, a user-edited one backed up then replaced) — so updating users stop carrying the dead block.
